summary: This directory provides headless layout components designed to structure the visual arrangement of forms and their constituent fields without imposing opinionated styling, allowing for flexible UI composition.
responsibilities: Defining the structural arrangement of form elements
Providing layout wrappers for individual form fields
relationships: The FormLayout acts as a container for organizing fields, while the FieldLayout defines the specific placement and presentation logic for individual inputs within that form.
designDecisions: Utilization of a headless architecture to separate structural definition from visual styling
Composition-based API for nesting child elements within layout wrappers
